# The examples a stranger can paste from our docs and from `help` output that are
# not yet executed by a test through the comparator (SPEC-TOOLWORK §7 rule 7).
#
# Every $  line in a fenced block of README.md, docs/USAGE.md, docs/CLI.md and
# docs/nova-swarm-quickstart.md, every example: line of a `help` banner pasted in
# a fenced block of those docs, and every example: line of every tool's own
# `help` banner under cmd/ (both listed as `example: <line>`), is either executed
# by a test through the comparator (compared_examples.txt) or listed here.
#
# THE LIST ONLY SHRINKS. TestIssue2218 compares it with its copy at the change's
# base: a row the change adds fails the class test on the PR that adds it, and an
# entry that matches no real example is a stale entry and a red run. Remove an
# entry by moving it to compared_examples.txt once a test executes it.
